W.note: Tiniest collapsed pill with ETA and count and a proper switch/tablist, but the opened timeline is clipped and multi-parcel tabs add clutter.

X.note: Clean two-line collapsed toast with progress bar, then a clear full timeline, carrier and number, with solid status roles and Esc support.

Y.note: Segmented progress and ETA are neat and accessibility is thorough, but the opened panel is crowded with tiny demo buttons and a cut-off timeline.

Z.note: Dense, polished teal-on-dark design with ETA, stops-away and tidy timeline, though it starts open and has less screen-reader support.
